opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Support for attending Society meetings and Society-sponsored meetings.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: The proposed project must support physiology teaching of a novel nature.
opportunities.summary: Support for developing new educational resources or conducting publishable educational research.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications should be physiological in nature.
opportunities.summary: Support for pilot studies, new techniques, and activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support hosting events at an institution, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars, or outreach events.

opportunities.title: The Paton Historical Studies Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members can apply for grants to promote research or engagement activities in the history of modern physiology.
opportunities.summary: Small grants to promote research or engagement activities in the history of modern physiology.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Support for postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members can apply for grants to support activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles.
opportunities.summary: Support for activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles.
